action_box_offline_currency_sub: Saved rates for when you are offline

action_box_command_at_sub: Space after msg — pick an app. @ then Space uses the first app in this list (drag to reorder). @wa still filters. Also text, email, send
action_box_command_apps_words_sub: Apps on this command and language shortcuts
action_box_command_words_only_sub: Language shortcuts — tap × to remove even the built-in ones
action_box_command_search_sub: DuckDuckGo ! shortcuts, your own ! words, and in-app search

action_box_common_apps_edit_hint: Type gm, calc, yt… Enter opens the app. Space opens its addon (keypad, search, compose). !gm still searches inside.

action_box_search_none: No searchable apps found on this phone.
action_box_remove_builtin_hint: Tap × to remove a word, including built-in English shortcuts like msg or /h.

action_box_open_updates_sub: GetApps or Play Store — tap Update all there
action_box_your_commands_hint: Type a shortcut word. Open an app, or run a quick combo like @WhatsApp with a contact already chosen.
action_box_shortcut_pick_combo_app: Pick an app for this combo
action_box_on_this_phone_hint: These commands don't open another app. Tap a word to change it (for example /s → sticky), × to remove it, or add another word.
action_box_command_words_hint: Words for built-in commands. Your own /d, do, stick picture commands are in Your commands above.
action_box_no_apps_drag: No apps — add or drag here
action_box_all_apps_in_command: Every installed app is already in this command.

action_box_shortcut_need_words: Type a word or /d, do, stick picture

action_box_add_contact_need_details: Type a name or number first

placeholder_add_command: + then a word, then pick an app
settings_hub_docks_subtitle: Height, icons, auto-hide, Action box and Apps buttons
extras_language_follows_system: Action box uses the phone language for menus and command help.
allow_contacts_sublabel: Needed to pick who to message
emergency_confirm: Opens the dialer. Confirm in the phone app.
send_sms_direct: Sends via %1$s without opening the app
via_app_opens: Opens %1$s with text ready (tap Send there)
actionbox_ott_calls_disabled: Messenger, Telegram, and other app calls aren't supported — tap for details in Not working.
action_box_offline_pack_sub: Currency rates and on-device translation. Answers stay in the box.
action_box_offline_pack_on: Downloaded. Currency works offline, and translation can run on this phone.

notes_compose_banner: Note — type text, then pick an app

note_press_enter: Press Enter for a sticky, or type first

news_pick_sources: Pick news apps and publishers to fill this page.
news_no_stories: No stories yet. Choose sources, or open a news app so MAD can pick up its headlines.
notif_enable_access: Enable notification access for live unread icons
qs_hint_tap_replace: Move tiles, tap × to hide, or tap a tile then an available one to replace it.
qs_hint_tap_available: Tap an available tile to replace the highlighted one.
recents_empty: Apps you open on this phone show up here.
recents_usage_access_hint: Turn on usage access to include apps launched from other apps (the phone recents list).
setup_description: A few Android settings need to be turned on for MAD Launcher to fully work. Tap a step to jump straight to it.
setup_row_home_title: Set MAD Launcher as your Home app
setup_row_home_why: This is what actually replaces your stock home screen. Without it, pressing Home won't bring up any of this.
setup_row_listener_why: Real alerts, unread icons, in-window reply, and the persistent media chips all need notification access.
setup_row_overlay_why: Needed for nav shortcuts, MAD floating windows, and sticky notes that stay on top of other apps.
setup_row_a11y_title: Turn on accessibility for nav shortcuts
setup_row_a11y_why: The round bell and gear sit on the system 3-button nav bar in every app. Screen content is not read.
setup_row_contacts_why: Action Box shows recent app threads first, then your phone contacts for @ # *.
setup_row_post_why: Local reminder toasts from MAD Launcher.
setup_row_battery_why: Keeps the notification listener from being silently killed in the background.
setup_row_usage_why: Lets Recents and Most used include apps opened from other apps — the same list Android keeps for the Overview screen.
setup_row_location_why: Coarse location only, so the home weather widget can show a real temperature.
setup_row_read_sms_why: Fallback when your phone does not mirror SMS to notification access — unread counts, MAD Messages rows, and alert sound from the SMS inbox.
help_app_search_desc: Type ! then a site (e.g. !yt cats, !p widgets). !p and !play search the Play Store app, or the website if it is not installed. Save your own !word under ActionBox Settings → DDG extras — an app, or a search= link.
help_at_desc: Type msg then Space — pick a messaging or email app, then a contact. Action box opens that chat ready to type. Also txt, text, message, mail, email, send.
help_filter_at_desc: @ filters messaging and mail apps. Tap opens. Hold does the Space addon. @ then Space uses the first app in ActionBox Settings → Message (drag to reorder).
help_filter_call_desc: # filters calling apps. Tap opens. Hold does the Space addon. # then Space uses the first app in the Call list. A number after # still dials.
help_filter_social_desc: : filters social apps. Tap opens. Hold does the Space addon. : then Space uses the first app in the Social list.
help_filter_video_desc: * filters video-call apps. Tap opens. Hold does the Space addon. * then Space uses the first app in the Video list.
help_filter_ai_desc: ? filters AI assistants. Tap opens. Hold does the Space addon. ? then Space uses the first app in the AI list.
placeholder_filter_apps: Filter apps — tap to open, hold for addon
action_box_filter_hint: Tap to open · Hold for addon
help_social_desc: Type post then Space — pick an installed social app (including Facebook). Action box opens the composer. No auto-post. Also social.
help_contact_lookup_desc: Type & then a name (or & then Space) — pick the person, then choose an app to message or call them. Also works with the word “contact”.
help_group_desc: Type ai then Space, then your question; pick an assistant if several are installed. Also ask ai.
no_ai_assistants: No AI assistants found. Install ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, or similar.
contact_lookup_banner: Find a contact, then message or call
help_call_desc: Pick a calling app (Phone, WhatsApp, Messenger, …), then a recent conversation. Aliases: dial, call, phone.
help_video_call_desc: Pick a video-calling app, then a recent conversation. Aliases: vid, video.
help_note_desc: Type /n then Space — pick a notes app (Keep, etc.) and create the note there.
help_add_contact_desc: Type /a or add contact then Space — name and optional number, then pick your Contacts app. Opens the add-contact screen.
help_translate_desc: Type /t, trans, translate, or !tr then Space — the field clears for your text. !translate does the same. Optional: from english to spanish. The translation stays in the box. Tap = to keep it and add another, up to 3. Pick a translator app if you want one.
help_sticky_desc: Saves a sticky note on the home screen. Does not open other apps.
help_reminder_desc: Opens Clock. /r or remind, then milk in 20 min for a timer, or pickup at 8pm for an alarm.
help_schedule_desc: Activity, date, and time — calendar insert.
help_window_desc: Bring up this full help window.
help_action_box_settings_desc: Your commands, built-in words, app lists, and permissions.
help_emergency_desc: Confirm, then open the dialer for 911.
help_update_desc: Type /u, update, or updates. Opens GetApps or Play Store on the updates list. Tap Update all there — MAD cannot install updates in the background.
help_nav_desc: Type /g, go, or !maps then Space — the field clears for a place. !map, !gmaps, and !waze do the same. nav, navigate, and go to still work. Pick Maps or Waze if installed.
dock_always_show_hint: Dock stays visible on the home screen.
dock_auto_hide_hint: Dock is hidden with a pull bar showing. Swipe or tap the bar to open.
dock_auto_hide_bottom_warning: The pull bar can interfere with opening the app drawer.
dock_show_over_apps_hint: Keeps this dock or its pull bar on screen while you use other apps. Needs draw-over permission.
frequent_usage_access_hint: Turn on usage access for a fuller ranking across Android.
frequent_empty: Use apps and MAD will pin the busiest ones here automatically.
settings_gestures_hint: Launcher gestures and nav shortcuts are in the main settings hub.
settings_home_notif_description: Home app, notification access, overlays, accessibility, contacts, and battery.
settings_nav_description: This launcher uses 3-button navigation. Gesture navigation is not supported.
settings_unapplied_body: You have changes that haven't been applied yet.
settings_hub_experimental_subtitle: MAD windows, Recents, and nav shortcuts
settings_experimental_intro: These extras replace system Recents, the notification shade, and Quick Settings. They are off by default because they do not work reliably on many phones.
settings_experimental_mad_windows: MAD Notifications and Quick Settings windows
settings_experimental_mad_windows_off: Off: Notifications opens the notification shade. Quick settings opens the extended shade (same as swiping down twice).
settings_experimental_mad_windows_on: On: Messages, System & apps, and Quick Settings open MAD's own windows instead of the system shade.
settings_experimental_help_window_off: Off: tap the Action Box pill to type. /h still lists commands.
settings_experimental_help_window_on: On: tap the Action Box pill for a menu of commands. /h is unchanged.
settings_experimental_widget_badges_off: Off: the MAD clock widget does not show unread app icons.
settings_experimental_widget_badges_on: On: unread app icons appear on the MAD clock widget.
settings_experimental_mad_recents_off: Off: Recents (pinch-out and Recents actions) opens the phone Overview.
settings_experimental_mad_recents_on: On: Recents opens MAD's own recent-apps window. Usage access fills the list from other apps.
settings_experimental_nav_shortcuts_off: Off: no overlay buttons on the nav bar, and MAD does not intercept nav taps. Placements stay saved.
settings_experimental_nav_shortcuts_on: On: overlay buttons and nav taps use your placements. Edit them below.
settings_experimental_need_grants_body: This needs extra permissions. Open each missing grant, then return here. Cancel leaves it off.
compat_upload_body: Optional name, email, and notes. Confirm sends a .txt and .json to the MAD GitHub reports folder.
platform_intro: MAD adapts to your phone's OS. Limited features stay usable but may not mirror the stock shade exactly.
platform_partial_sync_body: Some alerts may not match the status bar on this ROM. Dismiss in MAD may not clear the system shade.
platform_view_not_working: View details in Not working settings
platform_permissions_warning: %1$d features are limited on this device. Tap for details.
setup_row_xiaomi_autostart_why: Security app autostart keeps notification mirroring and nav shortcuts alive after reboot.
setup_row_xiaomi_battery_why: HyperOS often kills background listeners. Set MAD to unrestricted battery use.
compat_selftest_waiting: Finish the required permissions above — then MAD runs a compatibility self-test here.
compat_selftest_subtitle: Helps MAD learn what works on your phone. Re-check re-runs the probe. Upload sends the report to GitHub reports/compat.
compat_github_hint: Re-check only re-runs the probe. Upload sends a self-test to GitHub reports/compat. Bug reports use Extras.
settings_palette_hint: System follows the phone’s dark and light setting. Nord, Wallpaper, and Steampunk still switch with it.
settings_landscape_rotate_hint: Layout stays put — nothing scales or slides. Icons and names turn together in place. MAD clock stays stacked (clock, date, weather) and fills its cell; wide third-party strips stay as drawn. Leave off on tablets.
settings_infinite_home_pages_hint: After the last page, swipe wraps to the first (and vice versa).
settings_page_grid_hint: Grid for home pages, Most used, and the app drawer. Per-page override in the customize menu.
settings_icon_size_hint: Size of the icon inside each grid cell on home pages, Most used, and the app drawer.
settings_icon_bg_hint: Fades the app’s own icon fill. The glyph stays solid.
settings_no_wallpaper_colors: No wallpaper colors detected — set a wallpaper first.
settings_nav_classic_hint: Standard Android nav bar. No MAD overlay buttons.
settings_nav_bar_hint: Two seats on the nav bar; extras sit in the status shade. Tap the arrow to swap seats.
gesture_landscape_enabled_hint: Off by default so the home grid can scroll vertically in landscape.
settings_hub_share_apk_subtitle: Link or QR for the public download APK
share_apk_hint: The GitHub download link only works if you are signed in to the private repo. Tap Send APK to share the public build (no distributor token) over WhatsApp, Nearby, or Bluetooth.
share_apk_send_failed: Could not prepare the public APK
extras_language_hint: Choose a language pack. Changes apply immediately. Get more downloads packs from the MAD GitHub lang folder.
extras_no_more_languages: All listed packs are already installed.
extras_message_hint: Optional name and email. Write a bug, idea, or anything else.
dock_second_row_hint: Swipe up on the dock (not the home screen) to slide it up and show another row of 5 apps. Swipe up on the dock again for the app drawer.
dock_side_size_immediate: Side dock size applies immediately (no Apply needed).
settings_shape_applies_immediately: Shape applies immediately to home, dock, and drawer.
toast_updates_unavailable: No app store found for updates
glance_preview_hint: Drag a piece to move it. Drag the corner dot to resize it.
glance_background_sub: Own color behind the widget. The slider sets transparency either way.
glance_multi_hint: Drag a piece to move it. Drag the corner dot to resize it.
glance_multi_empty: Add Mad Multi Widget from the widget picker first.
about_actionbox_sub: This Action Box build, DuckDuckGo, and the modules it uses
about_modules_body: What the Action Box uses. Optional modules download only after you turn them on.
about_module_calc_role: Math in the Action Box. Included on this phone.
about_module_conversions_role: Temperature, weight, and pressure. Included on this phone.
about_module_currency_role: Live rates from DuckDuckGo, then the European Central Bank. Saved rates are optional.
about_module_fuel_role: Weekly retail price for this phone's country, in the local currency.
about_module_instant_role: Answers that stay in the Action Box.
about_module_bangs_role: The public shortcut list. A ! search opens that site.
about_module_translate_role: Optional. Language models download when you turn it on.
